s: This article details a system for local LLM integration with a FastHTML web framework, emphasizing structured file organization, and pragmatic use of diverse Python execution contexts (Cursor AI, Jupyter, CLI, web server) for efficient development and on-demand knowledge retrieval.
sub: Local LLM integration with FastHTML web framework.
Pragmatic use of multiple Python execution contexts (IDE, Notebooks, CLI, Server).
File organization as a filesystem database for project structure.
On-demand knowledge acquisition for LLMs ('Kung Fu downloads').
Managing LLM conversation context persistence manually.
